category_title: Low-achieving students with meaningful strategy construction and inconsistent performance (Type 1)
scenario_title: Regression in different contexts and later lessons
minimal_context: The student is working on a final written assignment involving verbal subtraction problems on a worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at this verbal subtraction problem on your final written assignment worksheet: 100 minus 38.50.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the paper) I don't know how to start. I can't remember how to use either of the strategies I developed before.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should try first?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I'm just failing to solve most of the tasks on this page.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to work it out on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do it. The questions are in a different context than before, so I'm failing these even though I could do this same difficulty level successfully last week.
